Times of Israel liveblog, 21 October 2026 (summary of entries)

Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that "Tehran has not received a response from Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthis on its mediation initiative." The offer came amid intensified Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia.
Yemen: An explosion occurred near Aden's airport, with a police official saying it was "caused by a Houthi missile."
Gaza: The IDF eliminated a Hamas operative involved in a 2025 tank attack that killed four soldiers.
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed meeting Netanyahu during a visit to Israel, declined to discuss details.
